docs.description: Hand-written: a union of two distinct sub-commands (VariousString/VariousFile) that each collapse onto a single inner field both named 'obj' (the mrtrix mrcalc/mrconvert shape). The @type comes from the sub-command id (via variantTag, which survives the single-field collapse), so both variants stay distinct and reachable; deriving it from the shared inner field name would make the second variant unreachable and the backend throws on the resulting duplicate @type.
